data.name: Anana
data.gender_notes: Anana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anana is derived from the Greek word 'anemos', which means 'wind' or 'breath'. In Greek mythology, Anemas was the god of the wind. The name Anana can be translated as 'grace' or 'beautiful flower'. The name Anana carries the meaning “Grace, beautiful flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anana usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beautiful flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of new beginnings and the grace of God in our lives.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
